title: StarGazer
text:
StarGazer is a forum on the AoPS Community, you are able to access it at http://artofproblemsolving.com/community/c106767_stargazer. StarGazer is all about astronomy and astrophysics. We discuss, debate, vote, and post news in StarGazer. There is a newspaper for the StarGazer Forum called AstroLive?¿, where we write a new article about once a week. To join the AstroLive?¿ Team (or to help writing the weekly articles), please go to http://artofproblemsolving.com/community/c106767h1115779_sign_up_to_be_on_the_astroliveiquest_team. The AstroLive?¿ Team is currently full with seven members, but we will recruit more later. We appreciate if you take a look at the StarGazer Forum.

~all the mods and admins of StarGazer
